title: Inference in Panel SVARs with Two-Way Dependence
abstract: arXiv:2610.11898v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We develop inference for heterogeneous panel vector autoregressive (VAR) models and their structural impulse response functions, where the error terms are dependent in the cross-sectional and time dimensions (two-way dependence). For proxy-identified structural VARs, we first adapt mean-group estimation and construct a closed-form pooled identification. Considering the reduced-form VAR dynamics, residual covariances, and structural parameters, we derive a joint central limit theorem under joint limits in the cross-sectional and time dimensions. We then propose a recursive-design panel moving-block bootstrap that resamples the estimated error terms in (i) the temporal, (ii) the cross-sectional, or (iii) both dimensions jointly, and prove consistency of the joint panel-block scheme under two-way dependence. Simulations show coverage close to the nominal level for the joint scheme but severe undercoverage for cross-sectional resampling.

translated_title: 具有双向相依性的面板结构向量自回归模型的推断
translated_abstract: 我们针对异质性面板向量自回归（VAR）模型及其结构脉冲响应函数发展了统计推断方法，其中误差项在截面维度和时间维度上均存在相依性（双向相依性）。对于通过外部工具变量（proxy）识别的结构VAR模型，我们首先改造了均值组估计方法，并构建了具有闭式解的合并识别方案。在考虑简约式VAR动态、残差协方差和结构参数的基础上，我们在截面与时间维度联合趋近的极限框架下推导了联合中心极限定理。随后，我们提出了一种递归设计的面板移动块自助法，可以分别对估计出的误差项在（i）时间维度、（ii）截面维度或（iii）两个维度联合上进行重抽样，并证明了在双向相依性下联合面板分块自助方案的一致性。模拟结果显示，联合方案的覆盖率接近名义水平，而截面重抽样则出现严重的覆盖率不足问题。
tldr: 本文针对误差项在截面和时间两个维度均存在相依性的异质性面板结构向量自回归模型，提出了联合中心极限定理和一致的面板移动块自助推断方法，解决了结构脉冲响应函数的统计推断问题。
en_tdlr: This paper develops inference for heterogeneous panel SVARs with two-way dependence in the errors, deriving a joint central limit theorem and proving consistency of a joint panel moving-block bootstrap for structural impulse response functions.
